column2: I say... I can use no more magic for now...
In that case, I shall take my leave first!
Yes! Before we fight, there is something I must tell you.
I wield $$暗黒魔法$$, power beyond anything you can imagine...
But without a single exception, magic that exists in this $$世界$$...
In other words, according to how you fight, my magic may live or die...
Bear that well in mind as you act!
Now, now. Do not target me! Leave the fighting to the young ones.
Good grief. Born from the earth, and already returning to it...
But your bodies shall never be wasted by me!
For us $$大神官$$s to use $$魔道$$, we require a great quantity of $$血$$ as a $$生けにえ$$ and catalyst.
And when that amount of $$血$$—BP—is full...
Watch closely! This is the sacred power passed down from antiquity: $$神聖ゾンビ魔法$$!!
And using the bodies of these zombies, I can do this as well!!
